content: ABARREḤ X WEDRAR
Řami iẓra Yasuɛ řɣaci, yuři ɣar wedrar, uca awarni řami din iqqim, usin-dd ɣares imeḥḍaren nnes.
Uca yarzem aqemmum nnes, isseřmed i-ten, inna:
Sseɛd n yinni arruḥ nsen izřeḍ, minzi Tageldit n ijenwan aqa-tt i nitni.
Sseɛd n yinni ittecḍinen, minzi nitni ad ttwaɛezzan.
Sseɛd n imwaḍɛen, minzi nitni ad warten tammurt.
Sseɛd n yinni ittřaẓan d yinni ittfaden ɣar tsegda, minzi nitni ad jjiwnen.
Sseɛd n yinni yareḥḥmen, minzi ad ɣarsen tiři arreḥmet.
Sseɛd n yinni i ɣar iǧa uř izdig, minzi nitni ad ẓaren AREBBI.
Sseɛd n yinni itteggen řehna, minzi nitni ad ttwasemman arrawen n AREBBI.
Sseɛd n yinni inneḥṣaren x ssibbet n tsegda, minzi Tageldit n ijenwan ad ɣarsen tiři.
Sseɛd i kenniw mařa ttɛayaren u ttdarracen xawem uca ad xawem inin ɛřam kuř awařen iɛeffanen x ssibbet inu, waxxa ssxarriqen.
Farḥem, sřiweřwem, minzi řmunet nwem d tameqqrant deg ijenwan, minzi ammu i tuɣa ttdarracen inabiyyen, inni qbeř nwem.”
“Kenniw d tameǧaḥt n temmurt. Maca mařa tameǧaḥt ixsar uředdi nnes, mammec ɣa negg ad tt narr d tameǧaḥt? War tneffeɛ ɛad i walu, ḥaca ad temmenḍar ɣar barra, ad xas ɛefsen iwdan.”
“Kenniw d tafawt n ddunect. Tandint i ittwabnan x wedrar, war tzemmar ad tᵉnnuffar.
War ssreqqin řefnar uca ad t ssarsen sadu řmud, maca ad t ssarsen x řmerfeɛ, maḥend ad yarɣ i marra inni iǧan di taddart.
Jjem tafawt nwem ad tarɣ i iwdan, ḥima ad ẓaren řexdayem nwem icnan, ad ssuɛřan Babatwem i iǧan deg ijenwan.”
“Aqa ad awem ittɣiř aqa usiɣ-dd ḥima ad ssbeṭṭřeɣ Ccariɛa niɣ Inabiyyen. Necc war dd-usiɣ ca ḥima ad ssbeṭṭřeɣ, maca ḥima ad kemmřeɣ.
S tidett, Necc ad awem iniɣ: Ař i ɣa iɛdu ujenna d temmurt, war ibeṭṭeř uřa d ijjen řḥarf niɣ d icten taneqqiṭ zi Ccariɛa ař ɣa yiři kuřci.

S uya wenni i ɣa issbeṭṭřen zi tweṣṣa-ya icten, waxxa d tameẓyant, uca isseřmad iwdan ammu, ad ittwasemma d ameẓyan di Tgeldit n ijenwan, maca wenni zzaysent iggin u isseřmad i-tent, netta ad ittwasemma d ameqqran di Tgeldit n ijenwan.
Minzi Necc ad awem iniɣ: Mařa tasegda nwem war tmeqqar ca x tenni n imseřmaden n idlisen d tenni n Ifarisiyyen, s tidett war tᵉttidfem ca ɣar Tgeldit n ijenwan!”
“Aqa tesřim belli ittwanna i řejdud: ‘War neqq!’, u: ‘Wenni ineqqen, ad ittwaḥaseb!’

Maca Necc ad awem iniɣ: Marra wenni ittxeyyaqen x umas břa ssibbet, nhřa ma ad xas ittwaḥakem, u marra wenni iqqaren i umas: ‘Ad xak ssusfeɣ!’, ad ittwaḥkem xas zzat i Jmaɛet Tameqqrant, u wenni iqqaren: ‘A abuhaři!’ ad ittwaḥakem, ad yadef ɣar tmessi n jᵉhennama.
Mařa tqeddmed tawhibt nnec x uɛalṭar min xef ssarsen tiɣarṣa d tewhibin, uca dinni tɛeqřed belli umac aqa-t ca xak,
ejj tawhibt nnec din zzat i uɛalṭar, ruḥ amezwaru, tṣeřḥed ak-d umac, xenni dweř-dd, uca ewc tawhibt nnec.
Iři twejded i weṣřaḥ ak-d weɣrim nnec umi cek ɛad akides deg webrid, ḥima aɣrim nnec war cek ittiwi ɣar řqaḍi, xenni řqaḍi ad cek yawi ɣar umxazni uca ad temmenḍared di řeḥbes.
S tidett, Necc ad ac iniɣ: War dd-teffɣed ssenni, ař ɣa txeǧṣed aṣuldi aneggaru.”
Aqa tesřim belli ittwanna: ‘War zenni ca!’,
maca Necc ad awem iniɣ, marra wenni i ɣa ixzaren ɣar temɣart s nnecwet, aqa izna deɣya akides deg wuř nnes.
Mařa tessenqarḍ cek tiṭṭ nnec tafusect, qess i-tt, nḍar i-tt xak. Iḥřa ac mařa iweddar ijj n ṭṭarf n arrimet nnec x uweṭṭu n arrimet nnec marra di jᵉhennama.
Mařa tessenqarḍ cek afus nnec afusi, qess i-t, nḍar i-t xak, minzi iḥřa ac mařa iweddar ijj n ṭṭarf n arrimet nnec waha x uweṭṭu n arrimet nnec marra di jᵉhennama.”
“Aqa ittwanna ɛawed: ‘Wenni i ɣa iǧfen i temɣart nnes, ad as iwc tabrat n waǧaf!’
Maca Necc ad awem iniɣ: Marra wenni i ɣa iǧfen i temɣart nnes, war iǧi zi ssibbet n farq-ccɣeř, ittarra i-tt ad tezna, uca wenni i ɣa imeřcen tenni umi iǧfen, aqa netta izna.”
“Aqa tesřim ɛawed belli ittwanna i řejdud: ‘War tejjaǧid ẓur, maca egg min tejjuǧed i SIDI!’
Maca Necc ad awem iniɣ: War tejjaǧam ɛemmarṣ, uřa ɣar ujenna minzi netta d řɛarc n AREBBI,
uřa ɣar temmurt, minzi nettat d tanebdat sadu iḍaren nnes, uřa ɣar tendint n Urcalim, minzi nettat d tandint n Ujeǧid d ameqqran,
uca war tejjaǧam uřa ɣar uzeǧif nnec, minzi war tzemmared ad tarred uřa d ijj n uẓeṭṭu n ucuwwaf d acemřař niɣ d abarcan.
Ad iqqim wawař nwem ‘Wah!’ d ‘Wah!’, ‘Lla!’ d ‘Lla!’. Mana ktar zi man aya, aqa netta zeg umɛeffan.”
“Aqa tesřim belli ittwanna: ‘Tiṭṭ s tiṭṭ d tiɣmest s teɣmest!’,
Maca Necc ad awem iniɣ, war tᵉttemɛařam ca ak-d ijj n uɛeffan, maca wenni i ɣa isseqqřen ameggiz nnec afusi, seřqa yas uřa d ameggiz nneɣni.
Mařa din ḥed ixs ad kik igg ccreɛ uca netta ad xak ikkes tcamir nnec, ejj i-t ad iksi uřa d ajeǧab.
Wenni xak iggin bezzez ḥima ad kides tuyured ijj n kilumitr, uyur akides tnayen.
Man wen d ac i ɣa ittaren ca n řḥajjet, ewc as tt, u wenni yarezzun ad xak yarḍeř, war d t ttarra amenni.”
“Aqa tesřim belli ittwanna: ‘Ad texsed jjar nnec, ad tcarhed řeɛdu nnec!’
Maca Necc ad awem iniɣ: Xsem řɛedyan nwem u barkem inni kenniw ineɛɛřen, ggem tcuni i yinni kenniw icarrhen, ẓaǧem i yinni kenniw ittawyen d imeḥbas d yinni xawem ittdarracen,
ḥima ad tiřim d tarwa n Babatwem i iǧan deg ijenwan, minzi Netta issneqqar tafuct nnes x iṣebḥanen d iɛeffanen, uca Netta yarexxu-dd i wenẓar, ḥima ad iwwet x imseggaden u x yinni war iseggden.
Minzi mařa texsem inni kenniw ittexsen, man arbeḥ i ɣarwem? Ma war tteggen ayt n ḍḍariba uřa ammu?
Mařa tseǧmem x wawmaten nwem waha, min i tᵉtteggem ktar x wenneɣni? Ma war tteggen ayt n ḍḍariba uřa ammu?
S uya iřim nican qaɛ am mammec uřa d Babatwem i iǧan deg ijenwan iǧa nican qaɛ.”

footnotes.text: Ccariɛa n Musa- ixs ad yini Ttawrat am mammec d as qqaren Wudayen.
’Jmaɛet Tameqqrant- niɣ: ‘Jmaɛet n řḥukkam imeqqranen n Wudayen’.
ijj n kilumitr- s Tramit ‘ijj n mayl’.
ayt n ḍḍariba- niɣ ‘iɛeccaren’. Ayt n ḍḍariba nitni d Udayen i ixeddmen ak-d řmexzen n Irumaniyyen, jemmɛen ḍḍariba. Ca zzaysen ksin zi ḍḍariba i yixef nsen.
